identity.athena_tagline: Your assistant for anything in the app: she plans, builds, remembers and answers.

setup.athena_enable_desc: When off, her orb, chat panel and footer icon disappear and her background work stops. Her pages stay here so you can switch her back on.
setup.overseer_enable_desc: Overseer watches the agents you star: how they run, what they cost and what they deliver.
setup.overseer_prerequisite: Star at least one agent to switch Overseer on.
setup.overseer_scope_desc: Overseer watches the agents you star. Starring an agent here also marks it as a favourite.
setup.curator_enable_desc: Curator keeps the mapped knowledge registry growing and checks your projects against it.
setup.curator_prerequisite: Map a knowledge registry to a workspace to switch Curator on.
setup.curator_registry_empty: No workspace has a registry mapped yet.
